opportunity._why: Σ numerators 2 + 2 over Σ effective denominators 4 + 3 = 4 / 7

all-or-nothing._why: p1 (50y): A met, excluded from B → counts; p2 (40y): both met → counts; p3 (30y): A not met; p4 (20y): neither → 2 / 4

linear._why: per patient share of met eligible components: p1 1/1, p2 2/2, p3 1/2, p4 0/2 → mean 0.625
